cell.label: BMI >25 or waist circumference >35 inches (88 cm) [female]; Waist circumference >40 inches (102 cm) [male]

Assess readiness to lose weight, set up goals and management strategy to achieve weight loss based on risk factors: nutrition, physical activity, behavioral management, pharmacologic therapy, surgical management.
See Management Recommendations based on BMI/risk of disease ().
Reassess monthly until 3 months then every 3 months for a year.
Reassess goals and risk factors and Counsel regarding weight maintenance and possible referral to a formal weight loss program.
Annual screening of height, weight, BMI.
